assessments.reasoning: The 20060427110041 raw OSI afl-2.0.php capture matches the pinned digest. Its v. 2.0 heading and “Licensed under the Academic Free License version 2.0” notice immediately following the work’s copyright notice precede the copyright, patent and source-code grants.
The pinned Index scope admits historical grants with identifiable text and edition. OSI’s v2.0 body meets that test even though the author ceased recommending it.

The September 2021 archive records Rosen’s withdrawal of support for pre-3.0 forms and his account of negotiations leading to 3.0. This places v2.0 within his earlier group while preserving his board-approval statement as a recollection.

challenge.method: Compared the main body with the AFL 3.0 sidebar, earlier-edition links and website footer. Checked whether withdrawal of a recommendation or the later correspondence establishes revocation, board action or SPDX deprecation.
challenge.results: The v2.0 heading and notice agree. The prior-version list names v1.2 and v1.1, and the footer concerns website licensing. No identified grant termination or edition-specific board action follows from historical status. SPDX’s v2.0 flag is false.

limitations: The author’s recommendation concerns edition choice. Determining the operation of a grant, including termination, requires the actual work, parties and circumstances.
reasoning: OSI publishes the v2.0 application notice and numbered grants alongside a warning that the author ceased to use or recommend this license. The warning and Rosen’s later chronology support the Index’s historical classification.
